objective: Independently confirm one exact passing Experiment 125 panel-response candidate on 65 previously unopened TeloHAEC panel target rows, using Experiment 128 production_log1p source units and integer-budget transport.

source.authorized_now: HDF5 structure, obs/var names, guide labels, target labels, and already-recorded cell counts only
source.forbidden_now: Any X or layer expression value, compact delta/b_ctrl value, candidate residual/confidence/support value, or biological metric

guide_replication.control_guides: all Experiment 105 eligible safe-targeting and non-targeting guides, equal guide weight
guide_replication.guide_effect: For each eligible guide, collapse duplicate feature symbols by summing counts; compute log1p(50000 * guide_pseudobulk / full unique-gene library); subtract the coordinate-wise median eligible-control-guide profile.
guide_replication.target_truth: Coordinate-wise median of all eligible guide effects for the target. No guide may be selected, dropped, or reweighted using expression values.
guide_replication.replication_report: Report per-target guide count, eligible-cell count, coordinate-wise guide sign agreement, and leave-one-guide range; these diagnostics cannot tune the candidate or gates.

candidate_binding.selection_rule: Choose the largest selected_candidate_counts_across_15_outer_target_folds value; break ties by earlier candidate_order. Require at least 8 of 15 folds and require the candidate definition transport to equal production_log1p.
required_candidate_artifacts: immutable artifact manifest and selection record

transport.baseline: TeloHAEC eligible-control-guide median profile over the full collapsed unique-gene axis
transport.library: floor of the median per-cell full-library count across cells assigned to eligible control guides
transport.eligibility: finite candidate residual and confidence, candidate support true, positive baseline abundance, control CPM strictly greater than 10, and response is not target-self
transport.integer_semantics: Use Experiment 128 source_coordinate_transform and deterministic largest-remainder redistribution of the pre-existing eligible off-diagonal panel integer budget. Copy target-self and every unsupported or ineligible coordinate exactly.
transport.comparison: Apply the exact same transport, baseline, library, eligibility, and fallback policy to Experiment 122 equal_mean_agreement.

support_and_fallback.structural_overlap_required: exactly the frozen 65 target labels and all 300 canonical response labels
support_and_fallback.pair_fallback: If the Experiment 125 candidate is unsupported at a coordinate, copy the transported Experiment 122 comparator effect and confidence exactly.
support_and_fallback.row_fallback: If a target row has no candidate-supported off-diagonal coordinate, the entire row is the comparator and cannot count as candidate-supported.
support_and_fallback.evaluation_denominator: All finite off-diagonal TeloHAEC truth coordinates are retained, including comparator fallbacks; unsupported candidate pairs are never dropped.

metrics.target_signed_credit: sum(sign(truth_j) * prediction_j) / sum(abs(truth_j)) across retained off-diagonal truth coordinates; targets are weighted equally
metrics.top20_truth_magnitude_weighted_sign_prec: Select ceil(0.20 * retained truth coordinates) by descending frozen candidate confidence with canonical response order tie-break; zero predicted sign is incorrect; weight correctness by abs(truth). Targets are weighted equally.
metrics.primary_effect: Experiment 125 candidate minus Experiment 122 comparator under identical transport and truth coordinates

target_label.definition: Fixed-point-free permutations of the 65 candidate target rows. Move residual, confidence, and support coherently; keep truth fixed; reapply destination target-self exclusion and the full fallback policy.

response_label.definition: After candidate binding, derive 10 equal-frequency bins from TeloHAEC control panel abundance with canonical ties, freeze the bins before targeting-guide values are read, and draw fixed-point-free within-bin response permutations. Move residual, confidence, and support coherently; keep truth fixed; reapply destination target-self exclusion and fallback.

nulls.complete_procedure: Each draw recomputes candidate transport, fallback, both target metrics, and candidate-minus-comparator deltas.
nulls.threshold: Observed macro delta must be strictly greater than each linear-method p95; add-one one-sided p must be <= 0.05.

bootstrap.definition: Sample the frozen 65 target labels with replacement and recompute equal-target macro candidate-minus-comparator deltas.
bootstrap.gate: Linear-method 2.5th percentile strictly greater than zero for both endpoints.

no_tuning_after_access: After the first TeloHAEC X/layer value is read, no candidate, dose, support rule, aggregation, metric, seed, null, bootstrap, threshold, axis, or implementation may change. A defect makes Experiment 130 terminally invalid and requires a new experiment number.
